Northwind Health Partners (fictional): Operations Coordinator (Remote, US)

Requirements:
- 2+ years of experience in operations, scheduling or office coordination, ideally in healthcare

Nice to have: QuickBooks, Spanish

Pay: $60,000 to $70,000 a year, plus health benefits.
Process: 30-minute recruiter call, 1-hour panel interview, a 2-hour scheduling exercise (AI tools allowed).
